entry.author: Sport New Zealand Ihi Aotearoa
entry.summary:
Dr Lucy Hone, Adjunct senior fellow at University of CanterburyWe close the conference with one of Aotearoa’s most respected voices on resilience and wellbeing. In this final session, Dr Lucy Hone brings together key themes from the past 2 days – strengthening foundations, leading through change and driving impact.
Drawing on her research and practical experience, Lucy will share insights into how sport and recreation leaders can build collective resilience, support their own wellbeing, and respond to change with clarity and purpose. This session brings the conference to a close, focusing on how to put what we’ve heard into practice.
